Pistola automática.name: Automatic Pistol
Pistola automática.effect: Allows +1 additional shot per Combat Action spent.

Mauser C69.name: Mauser C69
Mauser C69.effect: High-capacity magazine (15 rounds) and fast reload (1 Combat Action).

Carabina de repetição.name: Repeating Carbine
Carabina de repetição.effect: On the 1st Combat Action of your turn, allows +1 extra shot at a -1 penalty on Violence checks.

Derringer (revolver de bolso).name: Derringer (Pocket Gun)
Derringer (revolver de bolso).effect: Concealed sleeve gun; compatible with bonus damage from Ataque Sacana.

Espingarda de cano serrado.name: Sawed-Off Shotgun
Espingarda de cano serrado.effect: Short range, but can be wielded one-handed and carried in a waist holster.

Metralhadora montada.name: Mounted Gatling Gun
Metralhadora montada.effect: Wagon-mounted. Consumes your entire turn firing in a line without aiming, dealing 3 Life damage per Combat Action and Movement spent.

Canhão.name: Cannon
Canhão.effect: 3m blast radius; requires Violence TN 7. Misses scatter 3m randomly; critical failure hits allies.

Arco Composto de Caça.name: Compound Hunting Bow
Arco Composto de Caça.effect: On surprise attacks, grants +1 to Violence checks and +1 Life Circle of damage.

Explosivo (TNT/Dinamite).name: Explosive (TNT/Dynamite)
Explosivo (TNT/Dinamite).effect: Costs 1 Movement + 1 Combat Action. Requires Violence TN 7 (1.5m radius). On a natural 1, detonates in hand (Speed TN 6 check to dodge).
